subject: methylBaseDB vs. methylBase for covariates + NAs by Coercion message

messages.author: 8fad3182e4b25354
messages.subject: methylBaseDB vs. methylBase for covariates + NAs by Coercion message
parts:
Greetings! 

I am running into two separate issues. Disclosure: I am running the latest version of methylKit (1.5).

1. When including covariates into the model when running calculateDiffMeth with a methylBaseDB object, the results do not differ when compared to when calculateDiffMeth is run without covariates. However, when using a methylBase object, including the covariates will present different results than without. 

2. I am running into this warning message: "Warning message: In eval(quote(list(...)), env) : NAs introduced by coercion" after using diffMethPerChr. Upon further investigation I saw that this was specific to the X chromosome. If you take out the X chromosome and make the data set just autosomes, no warning message appears.

I have attached the R script to use, the data files, and text files with what the results should look like. Both issues will appear with the data set given. 

Thank you, 

Laetitia

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] methylBaseDB vs. methylBase for covariates + NAs by Coercion message
parts:
the issue 1 is because the flatfile database is overwritten, you can see that it writes out to the same filename methylDiff_e66b53b34fb6.txt.bgz in each case.

> myDiff_X.1_DB=calculateDiffMeth(meth_X.1_DB)
two groups detected:
 will calculate methylation difference as the difference of
treatment (group: 1) - control (group: 0)
compressing the file with bgzip...
making tabix index...
flatfile located at: /Users/uname/sandbox/methylDB_diffMeth_bug/methylDB 2018-03-11 Gx2/methylDiff_e66b53b34fb6.txt.bgz
> myDiff_X.1_MA_DB=calculateDiffMeth(meth_X.1_DB, covariates = maternalage)
two groups detected:
 will calculate methylation difference as the difference of
treatment (group: 1) - control (group: 0)
compressing the file with bgzip...
making tabix index...
flatfile located at: /Users/uname/sandbox/methylDB_diffMeth_bug/methylDB 2018-03-11 Gx2/methylDiff_e66b53b34fb6.txt.bgz

You can avoid it by adding an argument to make sure results are written to different files, although we should consider changing this behaviour. Different calculateDiffMeth results might be stored in different tabix files (I will check with Alex). But in this case, only the covariates are changing and the function is still applied on the same methylBase object. 
#Creation of methylDiffDB w/o covariates

myDiff_X.1_DB=calculateDiffMeth(meth_X.1_DB)

#creation of methylDiffDB w/ covariates 

myDiff_X.1_MA_DB=calculateDiffMeth(meth_X.1_DB,
                                   covariates = maternalage,
                                   suffix="MA_DB")

You can ignore the second issue.

Best,
Altuna

Thanks again, 

Laetitia
